_: Written by `ci-video narrate`. Records which line each mp3 is a read of, in which voice, on which engine, at what prosody — so a later edit to any of those can be detected instead of silently keeping the old recording. Commit this with the mp3s.

agent-memory-question.text: An agent that remembers you has to keep that memory somewhere. With Hermes on Companion Hub, that somewhere is hardware you own.

open.text: This is Hermes, the Companion Memory edition.

terminal.text: Open it from the Hub and it drops you into chat. Press Control D when you want the shell for commands like hermes model.

model-follows-hub.text: The model follows your Hub's inference settings. Add a cloud key in the Hub and it appears alongside the local model. It does not replace it.

connect-memory.text: Memory is its own app. Install Companion Memory, create an A P I key in its settings, and paste it into the Hermes install dialog.

recall.text: Once Hermes recalls something for a message, it tells you. You see a line beside the reply saying how many memories it used.

intents-as-tools.text: With memory connected, Hermes can call Companion's read-only intents as tools. Destructive or external ones are never registered, and the server refuses them anyway.

hub-tools.text: Hub tools are a separate, optional connection. Memory works without them. Turn them on and Hermes can reach the platform and the apps you have installed.

recap.text: The agent runs in its own sandbox on your Hub, the memory is on your hardware, and the source is public.

close.text: Hermes, from Companion Intelligence. UnCloud your life.
